mentions.name: WizRead
mentions.description: WizRead is an ebook reader app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with a modern, friendly UI. It lets users read books and share reading stats, goals, and ideas on a community platform; a mobile app and deeper community features integrated into the reading experience are planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a Ebook reader called WizRead with a friend for 2+ years now, as a side project. 
The goal is to create a platform where users can read and share their reading stats, goals, ideas, by also providing a modern & friendly UI.
mentions.author: alemilos
